turns.prompt_text: Sometimes I would like to output information into any Google product, whether that be a Google doc, a spreadsheet, or even a Google Keep note, is any of this possible so that I can have you add something to a cloud service?
turns.response_html:
Yes, that is absolutely possible! I can directly create, edit, and update information across several Google Cloud services. Depending on what you want to do, I can interact with Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Keep, and Google Drive natively through this chat.

Here is how you can use me to output information directly to those services:

1. Google Docs & Google Sheets

If you need to generate long-form content, structured tables, or data logs, I can create these files for you from scratch.

  • How to use it: Just ask me to "Create a Google Doc titled [Name] with..." or "Put this data into a Google Sheet." * What happens: I will generate the document or spreadsheet in the cloud and provide you with a clickable link and a file chip directly in our chat so you can open it instantly.
  • Editing: If you have an existing document, you can ask me to look at it and generate an updated version with edits, additions, or reformatting.

2. Google Keep (Notes & Lists)

If you want to quickly jot down a thought, save a snippet of code, track a project, or manage a checklist, I can interact with your notes and lists.

  • How to use it: You can say things like "Save a note called [Title] with this text," "Create a shopping list," or "Add [Item] to my task list."
  • What happens: I will create the note or list, or append items to an existing one, without you needing to open the app and type it out yourself.

3. Google Drive (File Uploads)

If we are working on a project where I generate a non-Workspace file format—such as a PDF, a Markdown file (.md), a CSV, or a script—I can upload that file directly into your Google Drive storage.

  • How to use it: Once a file is generated in our chat, just let me know you'd like it saved to your Drive, and I will upload it for you.

Whenever you're ready to export something, just tell me which product you want to send it to!

**Date:** June 19, 2026

Sometimes I would like to output information into any Google product, whether that be a Google doc, a spreadsheet, or even a Google Keep note, is any of this possible so that I can have you add something to a cloud service?

Yes, that is absolutely possible! I can directly create, edit, and update information across several Google Cloud services. Depending on what you want to do, I can interact with Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Keep, and Google Drive natively through this chat. 

Here is how you can use me to output information directly to those services:

#### 1. Google Docs & Google Sheets
If you need to generate long-form content, structured tables, or data logs, I can create these files for you from scratch. 
* **How to use it:** Just ask me to *"Create a Google Doc titled [Name] with..."* or *"Put this data into a Google Sheet."* * **What happens:** I will generate the document or spreadsheet in the cloud and provide you with a clickable link and a file chip directly in our chat so you can open it instantly.

#### 2. Google Keep (Notes & Lists)
If you want to quickly jot down a thought, save a snippet of code, track a project, or manage a checklist, I can interact with your notes and lists.
* **How to use it:** You can say things like *"Save a note called [Title] with this text,"* *"Create a shopping list,"* or *"Add [Item] to my task list."*
* **What happens:** I will create the note or list, or append items to an existing one, without you needing to open the app and type it out yourself.

#### 3. Google Drive (File Uploads)
If we are working on a project where I generate a non-Workspace file format—such as a PDF, a Markdown file (`.md`), a CSV, or a script—I can upload that file directly into your Google Drive storage.
* **How to use it:** Once a file is generated in our chat, just let me know you'd like it saved to your Drive, and I will upload it for you.

Whenever you're ready to export something, just tell me which product you want to send it to!
"""
